records.title: Lightweight Adaptation of General-Purpose VLMs for Multispectral and SAR Image Understanding
records.reason: Lightweight VLM adaptation targets multispectral/SAR task performance, not inference resource reduction.

records.title: YesTrack: Referring Multi-Object Tracking via MLLM-based Yes/No Verification
records.reason: MLLM-based referring multi-object tracking method, no direct inference efficiency claim.

records.title: Recommender System as Slow and Fast Thinkers
records.reason: The paper routes recommendation examples between a cheap fast path and a more expensive refinement path, evaluates selector routing and an accuracy–efficiency tradeoff, and reports normalized step-based inference cost rather than wall-clock latency. It is a concrete compute-allocation method for sequential recommendation, but does not study LLM inference/serving; relevance to the LLM inference-time-scaling line is adjacent and needs a workload/lineage check.

records.title: Do Better Imagined Rollouts Mean Better Robot Control? A Controlled Study of World-Model Evaluation Under Feedback
records.reason: Controlled evaluation of world-model prediction for robot control, not LLM inference optimization.

records.title: What Happens When the Model Eats the Stack? Rethinking the Research Agenda for Data Agents to Withstand the Bitter Lesson
records.reason: Research-agenda discussion for data agents, no concrete serving/inference resource method.
